
cdrom/cd-game-steps
Three games' CD steps with their spacing: a file search, medium seeks, a read back a few sectors.
Needs The X-Files Disc 1 (or any data disc of 31+ minutes). About a minute; nothing prints until the end.

FILE SEARCH (Nightmare Creatures): read 00:02:16 and Pause, then three times Setloc / SeekL / ReadN / Pause
  (00:02:18, :22, :23); cycles: Pause INT2 | SeekL INT2  ReadN INT1  Pause INT2 | ...
